test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the highlighted word(s) in the given sentence.

The **sceneries in Darjeeling** **are **breathtaking.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**scenery**" is an **uncountable noun** in English, and it does not have a plural form like “sceneries.”
 
• Therefore, it should be treated as singular and used with singular verbs such as "**is**."
 
• Using "**sceneries**" is grammatically incorrect, as standard English does not accept a plural form of "scenery."
 
• The correct and grammatically appropriate phrase is "**scenery in Darjeeling is**." 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4: scenery in Darjeeling is**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The scenery in Darjeeling is breathtaking."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scenery** is always singular and refers collectively to the natural features of a landscape.
 
• Incorrect: "The **sceneries** are beautiful." ✔ Correct: "The **scenery** is beautiful."
 
• Other uncountable nouns with no plural forms include: **furniture, luggage, information, advice**, etc.
